readiness_summary: 5★ and 6★ Hero Skill Kit catalogs are complete, taxonomy-separated, cross-linked with the Divine Weapon catalog, runtime-inert and regression-protected by 11 validators. The system is READY for the next safe phase (authoring tools), but NOT yet for runtime/battle activation. Borea remains catalog-only / launch_extra_premium / hidden from /api/heroes.

current_catalog_state.ui_state: read-only / 0 runtime-verb Pressables / descriptive copy only

safe_invariants: 5★ catalog: 20 entries, no ultimate, no DW, no Domain.
Marchio Boreale appears only on greek_borea (0 leaks).
Legacy borea hero_id absent across catalogs and /api/heroes.
primordial_gaia alias absent across catalogs and /api/heroes.
All loader/route files perform no DB writes and expose only GET endpoints.
UI files contain no non-GET fetch and no runtime-verb Pressables.

authoring_tool_recommendations.name: CLI script `author_hero_skill_kit.py` (catalog-only)
authoring_tool_recommendations.purpose: Add or edit a catalog-only kit entry without ever opening the JSON manually.
must_have: Schema validation against hero_skill_kit_schema_v1.json BEFORE writing.
ID canonicality check against approved 5★/6★ lists.
Slot progression check by rarity (5★ → 5 slots; 6★ → 6 slots).
final_numbers MUST be null until balance pass.
runtime_attached / battle_runtime_attached MUST be false until runtime task.
Backup the catalog file before writing (.bak in /app/backups/hero_skill_kits/).
Reject if catalog count would deviate from expected (5★=20, 6★=13).

authoring_tool_recommendations.name: Validator-suite runner `run_skill_kit_validators.py`
authoring_tool_recommendations.purpose: Single command to run all 11 catalog validators + audits and emit an aggregated PASS/FAIL report.

authoring_tool_recommendations.name: Read-only diff report `diff_skill_kit_catalog.py`
authoring_tool_recommendations.purpose: Compare current 5★/6★ catalog state vs a saved snapshot (e.g. last-approved JSON).
must_have: Highlight slot-level diffs (display_name, design_status, core_effect_tags, core_status_ids).

required_future_validators: validate_skill_kit_authoring_safety.py — schema/ID/slot/status whitelist + DW crosslink in one pass before any write.
validate_skill_kit_snapshot_integrity.py — snapshot vs current catalog drift detector.
validate_status_to_skill_resolver_contract.py — verify all core_status_ids referenced by kits exist in RM1.25-B status catalog (READ-ONLY contract check).
future_runtime_adapter_prerequisites: Final balance numbers attached (currently null) per slot.
Cooldown / chance / duration finalized per skill_type.
Status runtime resolver (currently RM1.25-B catalog is design-only).
HP bar status icon renderer + asset bindings (currently inert).
VFX runtime mapping (currently descriptive tags only).
battle_engine adapter to read kits from the catalog without bypassing balance gate.
API/runtime contract document (which fields are runtime-required vs design-only).
Mobile QA pass on iPhone 12/13/14 (390x844) and Galaxy S21 (360x800).
Feature flag SKILL_KIT_RUNTIME_ENABLED with default false + rollback switch.
Borea activation MUST remain a separate isolated task (not unlocked by this layer).

risks_and_stop_conditions.risk: Accidental runtime hook in adapter phase
risks_and_stop_conditions.stop_condition: If any battle_engine.py change or final_numbers becomes non-null without explicit balance task approval, STOP.
If greek_borea or legacy borea ever surfaces in /api/heroes, STOP and rollback.
If hero_skill_kit_schema_v1.json is modified without versioning to v2, STOP.
If any non-whitelisted status_id appears in core_status_ids outside marchio_boreale on Borea, STOP.
If aegis_of_athena / isis_sacred_tyet_knot / borea_wings_of_the_north_wind change, STOP.
